name: WeChat LocalMind
description: Zero-dependency on macOS, strictly read-only local WeChat 3.x and 4.x (WCDB) group chat (@chatroom) extractor, structured cleaner, CLI, and JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Stdio Server for AI Agents. Decrypts SQLCipher 3/4 shards in an isolated offline snapshot, physically blocks 1-on-1 private chats (wxid_*) and official accounts (gh_*), auto-decodes .dat XOR images, and makes zero outbound network calls.
applicationSubCategory: Local-first Chat Data Extractor & MCP Server
featureList: SQLCipher 3 (reserve=48) and SQLCipher 4 / WeChat 4.x WCDB (reserve=80) offline decryption using macOS CommonCrypto or cryptography/PyCryptodome
WeChat 4.x zstd in-memory decompression via Python 3.14 compression.zstd, libzstd.dylib, or zstd CLI
Multi-shard aggregation across message_0.db..message_N.db and MSG*.db with globally monotonic msg_id cursors
Triple-layer @chatroom physical isolation blocking 1-on-1 wxid_* DMs and gh_* official accounts (EXIT_POLICY_DENIED = 3)
4-tier real-name resolution (remark > group_nickname > nick_name > masked wxid) and @wxid_ mention normalization
XML and Protobuf wire parsing for 150-character <refermsg> quote chains, rich appmsg subtypes, revoked message stripping, and reversible ack folding
Adaptive magic-header XOR decryption for WeChat .dat images into .jpg, .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp, and .heic
11 CLI subcommands (+ list-groups alias), 4 read-only JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Stdio tools, and SKILL.md agent bundle
softwareRequirements: Zero third-party pip packages on macOS (uses built-in CommonCrypto and stdlib)
Optional cryptography or PyCryptodome on Linux/non-macOS for AES-256-CBC
